messages:
elaine-docs: Holding PR #4280 — docs-preview failed and there's an ambiguity in the SDK prefetch example about TTLs. Need runtime clarification before merge. @rob-runtime @paul-ml can you take a look?

ci-bot: docs-preview failed: linkcheck 404 on /sdk/prefetch-snippets -> page moved; runtime check failure: example assumes default_ttl=60 but test harness reads 0. Logs:
```
linkcheck: GET /sdk/prefetch-snippets -> 404
runtime-test: example_prefetch_default_ttl expected 60 but got 0
```

rob-runtime: I can explain. Runtime behavior differs by deployment: hosted endpoints apply a default prefetch.ttl=60s; Dedicated deployments do not force a default and instead rely on cluster-level cache_ttl (can be 0 to disable). The SDK example implies a universal 60s default which is inaccurate.

yasmine-eng: Is there a canonical "deployment-specific defaults" note in the API docs? The broken link looks like it was renamed when the prefetching page was reorganized. We should either restore the anchor or point to the new location.

paul-ml: For user-facing examples, easiest path is to make the snippet explicit. Change the snippet to set ttl and add a parenthetical note about deployment variance. Showing explicit config avoids CI/runtime mismatch.

elaine-docs: Proposal: 1) update the SDK snippet to include ttl explicitly (e.g. 60) and a short comment; 2) fix the docs anchor path to the new prefetching section; 3) runtime files an internal follow-up to document cluster-level cache_ttl behavior for Dedicated and provide an issue link. If 1+2 are done and linkcheck passes, I can remove the hold and merge.

rob-runtime: Agreed. I'll open the internal issue for the Dedicated cache behavior and paste the link here. I'll also check whether any runtime tests assume 60 and adjust the docs-test harness so it doesn't hard-code deployment defaults.

paul-ml: I'll push a change to the PR with the updated snippet. Proposed example:
```js
// explicit ttl to avoid relying on deployment defaults
const client = new Redwood({
  prefetch: { enabled: true, ttl: 60 /* hosted default; set explicitly to guarantee behavior */ }
});
```
That should make the runtime assertion match the docs-preview test.

yasmine-eng: I'll submit a small docs patch to redirect the old anchor to /sdk/prefetching and add a short "Deployment-specific defaults" callout under API behavior. Should be a one-line redirect plus the callout.

ci-bot: awaiting new push to PR #4280 to re-run docs-preview (linkcheck + runtime tests).

deploy-bot: merge policy note: docs team may apply label "docs/merge-hold" if runtime will follow-up. We can merge with that label only after linkcheck passes and the snippet is explicit.

elaine-docs: Thanks — blocking until: paul pushes snippet change, yasmine fixes anchor, and rob posts the internal issue link. After CI green I'll remove hold and merge.
